note: Greta has publicly told Donald how dare he, more than once, and he has called her a nasty little kid with a pamphlet; neither will give an inch.
history: Greta told world leaders how dare you at the UN in September 2019, and Trump tweeted that she seemed a happy young girl looking forward to a bright future. In December 2019 he told her to chill after she was named Time person of the year, and she changed her bio to say she was working on her anger management and watching a good old fashioned movie. In November 2020 she turned the same line back on him over the vote count. In January 2025 he took America out of the Paris climate agreement again.

note: Both fill any room they enter with their own big plans and cannot stand sharing the stage; Donald thinks Elon's napkin sketches are small-time, Elon thinks Donald's towers are slow.
history: Musk gave about $250 million to Trump's 2024 campaign and was rewarded with the DOGE cost-cutting team in 2025. In May 2025 he left his job and on 5 June they fell out in public over the Big Beautiful Bill, with Trump threatening his contracts and subsidies and Musk calling the bill a disgusting abomination. In July he announced an America Party. By late 2025 they were back on speaking terms.
